additional_info.subject: 0424234 - ID0424234-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312569868/03] Charging issue CRM:00314000170
additional_info.body:
Good evening Bastien,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0424234
, which was opened for a charging session on charger
ajiYXz
which lasted 21 hours.
I had a look at the charger, but it seems that we had a loss of communication with our SCB, as we do not have logs between
2025-05-07T15:38 and
2025-05-08T12:34.
Due to the missing logs, I cannot say exactly what happened. When the charger came back online, it usually sends a huge bunch of logs from previous days, as a duplicate. In these logs, I cannot see anything related to Launched Reboot, or FW update or other type of FW issue.
What I can see is that the OCPP Backend connection of router 2 was re-established on 2025-05-08T12:39:58, when we received the Boot notification. As soon as the OCPP Backend connection is re-established, we send to the Backend the Stop Transaction command for transactionId :
48219445
(which started at 2025-05-07T15:20:07).
The only valuable information we receive it in the Stop Transaction command:
2025-05-08T12:39:58.804834+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/431e9887adef[647]: OCPP: Send command: StopTransaction (88126ff5-05c8-4dba-9be7-86e879a1c74d) - {"meterStop":62600657,"timestamp":"2025-05-08T12:36:21.469Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2025-05-08T12:36:21.469Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"30957","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"Energy.Active.Import.Interval"}]}],"reason":"
PowerLoss
","transactionId":48219445}
As suspected, everything goes into the direction of a PowerLoss, so a sudden interruption of the power supply from the grid to the charger. I would then suggest to please check with your grid operator if any shortage or cut of power supply happened on that location.
As no further analysis can be done, based on the data we received, I will proceed to close this ticket, as the root-cause seems to be a power loss from the grid.
In case further analysis is required from your side on this charger or on similar issue, kindly open a new ticket and our support Team will investigate for you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
